parameters.query:
SELECT memory_id, memory_type, fact_or_claim, source_id, confidence, sensitivity, valid_from, valid_to, verification_status
FROM memories
WHERE owner_id = $1
  AND ($2::text IS NULL OR organization_id = $2)
  AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > now())
  AND ($3::text IS NULL OR memory_type = $3)
  AND to_tsvector('english', fact_or_claim) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', $4)
ORDER BY confidence DESC NULLS LAST, valid_from DESC
LIMIT $5;
